title: Guard expired-claim reclaim in claim command
description: claim() currently lets a new agent silently overwrite an expired claim. Per spec, an expired claim must first be reaped via `release --expired --reason <text>` so the takeover is an explicit, audited event. Make claim() refuse to claim a task whose claim file exists but is expired, with an error directing the agent to release --expired first.
acceptance_criteria: claim on a task with an expired claim fails with an error mentioning release --expired
claim succeeds after the expired claim is reaped via release --expired --reason
existing test suite stays green and a new test covers the guard
